title: Pollution and an exam-score contrast
hook: Two stated cases: explore the score scale behind a standardized contrast.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the score scale behind a standardized contrast affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines D, regardless of the stated inputs.
